name: extension-title-block-document-details
description: The title-block-document-details extension drawing a labelled details block on a title page. Proves the extension's effect matches the canonical toolchain — without a passing comparison against reference output, a claim that the extension matches is an assertion rather than a fact, and the extension is not done. The details list covers all three forms in one document: a labelled detail, a detail whose attribute is unset (omitted rather than drawn empty), and a bare attribute name rendered without a label. The theme sets all three contributed keys away from their defaults. Worth recording why this fixture is about LAYOUT rather than content: interpolating attributes into the title block is already native via title-page.authors.content, which is attribute-substituted; what is not reachable by theme alone is putting each detail on its own line, because ink_prose normalizes whitespace and collapses any multi-line template onto one line.
